description: This Java source file defines the RmTypeDefs class which provides functionality to identify and remove typedef annotation classes such as @IntDef and @StringDef in Android projects. It includes logic to locate, analyze, modify, and delete class files related to these annotations, and to rewrite outer classes to ensure references to deleted inner classes are updated accordingly.

classes.name: RmTypeDefs
classes.description: Main class providing functionality for detecting, analyzing, and removing typedef annotation classes from Java bytecode files.

classes.name: TypeDefVisitor
classes.description: Inner class extending ASM's ClassVisitor to analyze class files to identify typedef annotations and their properties.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the utility from command line; parses arguments and triggers processing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up the environment based on arguments and orchestrates the process of checking files, rewriting classes, and deleting typedef classes.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Recursively visits directories and checks each .class file for typedef annotations.

methods.name: checkClass
methods.description: Reads a class file and processes it with TypeDefVisitor to determine if it's a typedef annotation class.

methods.name: addTypeDef
methods.description: Records a class name and file as a detected typedef annotation for later processing.

methods.name: rewriteOuterClasses
methods.description: Updates outer classes to remove references to inner typedef annotation classes marked for deletion.

methods.name: deleteAnnotationClasses
methods.description: Deletes the files for the typedef annotation classes identified.
